title: Reaction-time prediction from pre-response EEG
scientific_question: Does EEG available before a fixed cutoff improve reaction-time prediction beyond contrast and instruction?
primary_outputs: Reaction-time estimate per trial from a window whose length does not depend on the response.

split.policy: Outer held-out participants; within training people group complete trials by block and instruction; no response-dependent query cutoff.
